def transform(grid):
    # Extract the distinctive color-6 pattern as a compact binary output.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 6]
    if not cells:
        return [[0]]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[8 if grid[r][c] == 6 else 0
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
